methods.name: pages.edit
methods.summary: Change part of a page by find-and-replace, without resending the whole page.
methods.details: Each edit's find must match the page's Markdown exactly once (copy it from pages.read or editor.getMarkdown); whitespace differences are tolerated. Set all: true to replace every match. Edits apply in order; if one fails nothing changes. Open pages keep untouched blocks. Prefer this over pages.write / editor.setMarkdown for anything smaller than a rewrite.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: pages.setBackground
methods.summary: Set the background behind a whole page: a color, gradient, image or animated ASCII scene (null clears).
methods.details: kind color: value is a CSS color (hex, rgb()/hsl()/oklch(), a name or var(--token)). kind gradient: value is a CSS linear-/radial-/conic-gradient (no url()). kind image: value is an https URL, a data:image URL (max 48 KB) or an uploaded asset (/__assets/…). kind ascii: ascii = { scene (required): ascii-moon | ascii-sunset | ascii-galaxy | ascii-rain | ascii-dunes | ascii-topo ("moon" ok), speed 0.25–3 (default 1), ink "#rrggbb", density fine|normal|large, still: bool, cursor: bool }. Uses the same ASCII engine as Home backgrounds. opacity (0–1) fades the background; dim (0–1) lays a page-colored veil over it so text stays readable (defaults: image 0.35, ascii 0.55, else 0). Saved per workspace. Users set it from the page ⋯ menu → Background….

pageId.description: Page id. Default: the active page.

background.description: { kind: color|gradient|image|ascii, value?, ascii?, opacity?, dim? }, or null to remove.

methods.example: await noteral.pages.setBackground({ background: { kind: 'ascii', ascii: { scene: 'rain', speed: 0.8 }, dim: 0.6 } })

methods.name: databases.create
methods.summary: Create a database (a page in the tree) with properties and a first view.
methods.details: To put a database inside a page's content, use databases.embed instead. Property types: text, number, select, multiSelect, status, date, checkbox, url, email, phone, createdTime, lastEdited, formula (give `formula`).

formula.description: Formula source (type formula), e.g. {Price} * {Qty}, if({Done}, style("Done", "green"), fromNow({Due})) or formatNumber({Ratio}, "percent"). May span lines with // comments. Validated; see databases.formulaFunctions.

dateFormat.description: How date results of a formula show.

display.description: How a number (or number-formula) property shows its value. Merged over the current display on updateProperty.

style.description: number = plain text (clears the display); bar / ring = progress toward max; rating = stars; heat = tinted by size.

color.description: Fill colour; default = the app accent.

max.description: The value that counts as full (bar/ring/heat; default 100, or 1 for percent format). For rating: the number of stars, 1–10 (default 5).

showNumber.description: Bar / ring: also show the number (default true).

customType.description: For type custom: a registered property type id (databases.listPropertyTypes), e.g. "rating".

config.description: For type custom: per-property options the type defines (its config fields), merged into the current ones; null for a key removes it.

methods.name: databases.embed
methods.summary: Put a database inside a page's content: a new inline database, or a linked view of an existing one.
methods.details: With databaseId the block links that database (it stays where it is). Without it a new database is created as a child of the page (title, properties, view as in databases.create). Inserts at the end unless position says otherwise; before/after need blockId (from editor.getBlocks) or anchor (text of a block). Works whether or not the page is open. In page Markdown an embedded database is the line <!-- database:ID Title -->; keep it when editing.

pageId.description: Page to insert into. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

databaseId.description: Existing database to link. Omit to create a new inline database.

formula.description: Formula source (type formula), e.g. {Price} * {Qty}, if({Done}, style("Done", "green"), fromNow({Due})) or formatNumber({Ratio}, "percent"). May span lines with // comments. Validated; see databases.formulaFunctions.

dateFormat.description: How date results of a formula show.

display.description: How a number (or number-formula) property shows its value. Merged over the current display on updateProperty.

style.description: number = plain text (clears the display); bar / ring = progress toward max; rating = stars; heat = tinted by size.

color.description: Fill colour; default = the app accent.

max.description: The value that counts as full (bar/ring/heat; default 100, or 1 for percent format). For rating: the number of stars, 1–10 (default 5).

showNumber.description: Bar / ring: also show the number (default true).

customType.description: For type custom: a registered property type id (databases.listPropertyTypes), e.g. "rating".

config.description: For type custom: per-property options the type defines (its config fields), merged into the current ones; null for a key removes it.

view.description: First view type of a new database.

anchor.description: Or: text from the anchor block (first block containing it).

methods.returns: { databaseId: string; pageId: string; created: boolean }
methods.example: await app.databases.embed({ pageId, title: "Tasks", properties: [{ name: "Status", type: "status" }, { name: "Due", type: "date" }], view: "board" });

property.description: Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title).

methods.example: const late = await app.databases.queryView({ databaseId, filters: [{ property: "Due", op: "before", value: "2026-01-01" }], sorts: [{ property: "Due" }] });

logScale.description: Logarithmic value axis (zero/negative values are left out).

labelContent.description: What data labels show. Default value (bars/lines), namePercent (pies), nameValue (funnels).

labelPosition.description: Where data labels sit; unset picks per chart.

color.description: Colour of single-colour charts: accent or an option colour (gray, brown, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, red).

curve.description: Line shape (line/area/radar); overrides smooth. Default straight.

points.description: Point markers on lines; unset shows them when there are few points.

gradient.description: Area fill fades out. Default true.

donutWidth.description: Donut ring thickness, % of the radius. Default 34.

other.description: With limit: merge the rest into Other (default true) or drop it.

aggregate2.description: Combo chart (column/line/area): a second measure drawn as a line on a right axis. "" clears.

tooltip.description: Tooltip: group (all series at a category, default), item (one mark) or off.

emptyText.description: Message shown when the view has no rows.
